versions.changelog:
- Removed the dependency on API keys; configuration step for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY eliminated.
- Updated documentation to clarify that all AI processing is handled server-side via api.gitrama.ai with no user API key required.
- Revised metadata to remove the API key requirement for installation and usage.
- Switched script path from scripts/verify.sh to script/verify.sh for improved consistency.
- Provided more details in the documentation about data flow and privacy: all intelligence and analysis now occur on the server, with no sensitive data processed locally.
Initial release — AI-powered git history intelligence for OpenClaw. Includes AskGIT semantic chat, smart commit message generation, branch name generation, and repo insights.
